title: Good News at the Party
setting: A bright house party and a garden under a cloudy sky.

characters.name: Dan
characters.look: Dan (a tall man of about forty with a short brown beard and a navy jumper)

characters.name: Anna
characters.look: Anna (a woman of about forty with shoulder-length red hair, round glasses and a teal cardigan)

sentences.en: Dan and his wife Anna are at a party.
sentences.zh: 丹和妻子安娜在参加一个聚会。
sentences.scene_prompt: Dan (a tall man of about forty with a short brown beard and a navy jumper) and his wife Anna (a woman of about forty with shoulder-length red hair, round glasses and a teal cardigan) arrive at a bright house party.

sentences.en: The house is busy and full of light.
sentences.zh: 屋子里很热闹，灯火通明。
sentences.scene_prompt: A crowded room with many bright lamps, Dan (a tall man of about forty with a short brown beard and a navy jumper) and Anna (a woman of about forty with shoulder-length red hair, round glasses and a teal cardigan) among the guests.

sentences.en: A lot of people talk and laugh inside.
sentences.zh: 里面有很多人在聊天说笑。
sentences.scene_prompt: Many guests stand in groups, talking and laughing in the bright room.

sentences.en: First, they look for a glass of wine.
sentences.zh: 首先，他们去找一杯葡萄酒。
sentences.scene_prompt: Dan (a tall man of about forty with a short brown beard and a navy jumper) and Anna (a woman of about forty with shoulder-length red hair, round glasses and a teal cardigan) look around the crowded room for drinks.
sentences.draw_note: Shows them looking around the room; 'first' and what they look for can only be guessed.

sentences.en: They find red wine on a long table.
sentences.zh: 他们在一张长桌上找到了红葡萄酒。
sentences.scene_prompt: Dan (a tall man of about forty with a short brown beard and a navy jumper) and Anna (a woman of about forty with shoulder-length red hair, round glasses and a teal cardigan) pick up glasses of red wine from a long table.

sentences.en: Dan says something personal into Anna's ear.
sentences.zh: 丹在安娜耳边说了些私密的话。
sentences.scene_prompt: Dan (a tall man of about forty with a short brown beard and a navy jumper) leans close and speaks quietly into the ear of Anna (a woman of about forty with shoulder-length red hair, round glasses and a teal cardigan), near the garden door.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Dan speaking quietly into Anna's ear; what he says can't be shown.

sentences.en: As they walk outside, the sky is cloudy.
sentences.zh: 他们走到外面时，天空阴沉沉的。
sentences.scene_prompt: Dan (a tall man of about forty with a short brown beard and a navy jumper) and Anna (a woman of about forty with shoulder-length red hair, round glasses and a teal cardigan) walk out into a garden under a grey cloudy sky.

sentences.en: Happy Anna runs to hug him by the flowers.
sentences.zh: 安娜高兴地在花丛边跑过去抱住他。
sentences.scene_prompt: Anna (a woman of about forty with shoulder-length red hair, round glasses and a teal cardigan) runs happily to hug Dan (a tall man of about forty with a short brown beard and a navy jumper) beside bright flowers in the garden.
